correctness.rationale: The Q_(i,a) family consists of 2r adjacent spoke-layer edges, three center-cycle edges and one leaf edge, pairwise conflicting: a 2r+4 conflict clique. If 2r+4 colors exist, every such clique is saturated and all leaf edges at same i share color c_i. Counting each color over six cliques gives 2S+3H+E=6; H,E<=2 and repeated C6 edges must be at opposite indices. Any color with E>0 forces (H,E,S)=(1,1,1) or (0,2,2), yet forbidden spoke-layer intervals cover all six indices, contradiction. The explicit r=2 nine-color table is a valid induced-matching coloring in an independent 30-edge/edge-conflict check, and induction copying leaf-cycle colors while using two fresh parity spoke colors gives 2r+5. The star is an edge-subgraph of a graph at maximum degree, yielding universal sharp lower bound. Independent script verified local 8-cliques and seed, not unbounded r; the induction proves that portion.
